About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

This role is for a high-impact engineering leader who has been in the trenches at fast-scaling startups — someone who has grown from individual contributor to leader and helped scale engineering orgs through multiple phases of growth. Ideally, you've done it more than once.

As a senior designer you will set the quality bar, own our systems and patterns, and define the look and feel of an AI powered coach that meets players inside their favorite games and our studio customers.

Things you’ll do

Lead end-to-end product design from discovery and flows to polished prototypes and user testing.
Turn ambiguous ideas into cohesive UX that drives core business outcomes around activation, retention and onboarding (First session clarity, engagement loops etc)
Partner with product and data science to run lightweight usability testing, interpret activation and retention funnels, and use insights to iterate quickly.
Obsess about impact, first on onboarding, first session clarity, and engagement loops.
Build and own our design system for speed and consistency across surfaces
Work with product, engineering, and data science to ship high q

title: Senior Product Manager - Build Engineering Reviews

North America, Remote

About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role 

As a Senior Product Manager on the Build Engineering Reviews team at CoLab, you’ll own one of the most strategically important areas of our platform: how engineering teams collaborate, review designs, and make better decisions together.

title: Vice-President, Strategic Growth, Productivity & Innovation
description:
Humber Polytechnic is seeking a visionary leader to serve as their Vice-President, Strategic Growth, Productivity & Innovation (VP, SGPI).

This is a rare opportunity to shape the future of a leading Canadian polytechnic while influencing the evolving role of post-secondary education in driving economic growth, productivity, and social impact. Operating at the centre of Humber Polytechnic’s strategic agenda, the VP, SGPI will be uniquely positioned to design and lead an integrated growth model that brings together education, industry, government, and global partners in new and transformative ways.

At a time of profound disruption across higher education, driven by changing learner expectations, technological advancement, and shifting economic conditions, this role offers the chance to build something fundamentally new. The VP will architect Humber’s next-generation growth engine, redefining how institutions expand access, diversify revenue, and deliver lifelong learning at scale. Central to this mandate is the ability to drive measurable growth in revenue through the development of new market opportunities, innovative partnership models, and scalable education and service offerings, including those delivered through complex domestic and international collaborations and contractual arrangements. Through this work, the VP will extend Humber’s reach and impact while positioning the institution as a national leader in productivity and a global innovator in polytechnic education.

With four campuses across Saskatchewan, the university provides a learning environment that integrates Indigenous perspectives, cultures, and histories while preparing students for success. As a federated college of the University of Regina, FNUniv offers undergraduate and graduate programs in business, humanities, social sciences, and sciences—all incorporating Indigenous worldviews, traditions, and languages.

Founded in 1976 as the Saskatchewan Indian Federated College (SIFC), FNUniv was renamed in 2003, reinforcing its commitment to Indigenous-led post-secondary education. At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

Conduct environmental scan and literature review to inform content and materials development, along with training needs

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

At CoLab, we want to help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

CoLab is a cloud based platform for engineering design review. We make it easy for subject matter experts (SMEs) across your business to access, evaluate, and comment on 2D drawings and 3D models. OverviewApplication

About Us

Propel is on a mission to empower low-income Americans by simplifying access to government benefits with modern technology. We're a passionate team of 100 Propellers - all working to help our users get through the month, every month.

The Role

Millions of Americans navigate a social safety net that too often works against them - confusing enrollment, broken eligibility systems, policies that never reach the people they're meant to serve. Propel exists to change that. And increasingly, the path to change runs through the states that administer these programs.

When Propel builds credible relationships with state agencies, we don't just grow the business - we create direct pathways to improving life for the people we serve. A state that understands how its users are falling through the cracks can actually fix it. But that requires state leaders to know what Propel sees and trust the source.

The Growth & Insights Lead will make that possible by reaching the right agency decision-makers, producing insights grounded in real user experience, and developing messaging that earns trust in a complex public sector environment. Guided by a steadfast commitment to academic excellence, equity, inclusion, innovation, and strong community partnerships, the Kawartha Pine Ridge District School Board (KPR) focuses on delivering world‑class education and supporting the success, well‑being, and lifelong learning of every student. Serving approximately 35,000 learners across 89 schools in the Municipality of Clarington, Northumberland and Peterborough Counties, and the City of Quinte West/Murray Ward, KPR supports diverse rural and urban communities and is dedicated to fostering environments where all students can thrive.

The board is situated on the traditional territory of the Michi Saagiig Anishinaabeg people, serving the three Indigenous communities of Alderville First Nation, Curve Lake First Nation, and Hiawatha First Nation.

Today, the land on which the Kawartha Pine Ridge District School Board gathers is home to many First Nations, Métis and Inuit peoples and we acknowledge the contributions and accomplishments of all Indigenous people across Turtle Island, current and throughout history.

Kawartha Pine Ridge District School Board is seeking a Chief Executive Officer (CEO), who will advance organizational performance, implement the Board’s strategic direction, and ensure the effective, transparent, and accountable operations of a large and complex publicly funded school system.

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner. Our product, CoLab, is the world’s first Design Engagement System (DES) - a category defining product that Engineering teams use to engage in meaningful, productive design conversations, catch preventable mistakes, and get to market faster. Our customers include the largest engineering organizations in the world such as Ford, Johnson Controls, Komatsu, and Polaris in the industrial equipment, consumer products, automotive, aerospace & defense, and shipbuilding industries.

title: Data Operations Specialist
location: St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada
description:
Enaimco’s Asset Lifecycle Management (ALM) platform is the place where integrity work happens, embedding daily operations inside a living system of understanding. By connecting physical assets to relevant, searchable digital data, we embed operational workflows directly inside a continuously updating digital twin. This transforms manual data reconciliation into automated clarity, ensuring every engineering decision is based on a current, complete view.

That complete view is just the foundation. By turning asset data into a continuously learning system, our platform delivers contextualized insights today and lays the groundwork for predictive decision-making tomorrow.
We’re looking for a Data Operations Specialist to own how customer data is structured, cleansed, mapped, and validated as it moves into our platform. This is the role that sets the standard for how we handle the messy industrial data our customers bring us, and the discipline that lets every subsequent implementation be faster, more traceable, and more reliable than the last. You’ll be the person who decides how data should be organized for ingestion and ongoing use, then holds the line on those rules across every project.

CAREER AND YOUTH SERVICES

Equiforce provides innovative, responsive, and industry-informed workforce development initiatives that build equitable pathways into the industries shaping Newfoundland and Labrador’s future and connect women and gender-diverse individuals with opportunity.

CAREER PROGRAMS
FASTTRACKHER

An innovative workforce readiness initiative aimed at preparing women for high-demand industries. FastTrackHER is a new pilot in development for 2026. Short, intensive, and industry-informed, it creates pathways into underrepresented fields through sector connections, relevant certifications, and direct insight into emerging industry opportunities. The first pilot focuses on Newfoundland and Labrador’s construction sector in the Avalon region, with future iterations expanding to other industries across the province.

PATHWAYS TO PLACE

A province-wide pilot launching in 2026 that connects newcomer and immigrant women with eight-week, paid, work-integrated learning placements in local organizations. Participants gain workplace readiness skills, valuable Canadian experience, professional networks, and wraparound supports that promote success and belonging. Employers, in turn, strengthen their capacity through structured guidance that supports inclusive hiring, onboarding, and workplace practices.

For more information and to learn how to participate, click here.

Equiforce provides innovative, responsive, and industry-informed workforce development initiatives that build equitable pathways into the industries shaping Newfoundland and Labrador’s future and connect women and gender-diverse individuals with opportunity.

CAREER PROGRAMS
FASTTRACKHER

An innovative workforce readiness initiative aimed at preparing women for high-demand industries. FastTrackHER is a new pilot in development for 2026. Short, intensive, and industry-informed, it creates pathways into underrepresented fields through sector connections, relevant certifications, and direct insight into emerging industry opportunities. The first pilot focuses on Newfoundland and Labrador’s construction sector in the Avalon region, with future iterations expanding to other industries across the province.

PATHWAYS TO PLACE

A province-wide pilot launching in 2026 that connects newcomer and immigrant women with eight-week, paid, work-integrated learning placements in local organizations. Participants gain workplace readiness skills, valuable Canadian experience, professional networks, and wraparound supports that promote success and belonging. Employers, in turn, strengthen their capacity through structured guidance that supports inclusive hiring, onboarding, and workplace practices.

Stewart McKelvey has a long history of being a leader in Atlantic Canada. And being a leader means embracing innovation.

We changed the traditional approach to law student recruitment in Atlantic Canada. Typically, Articled Clerks wait for “hire-back” decisions well into their articling year.

Stewart McKelvey is thinking differently.

Facilities and Civil Work Manager
Facilities and Civil Work Manager

Responsibilities:

•     Oversee the maintenance, repair, and operation of all company facilities and infrastructure.

•     Conduct routine inspections to ensure facilities, utilities, and security systems are operating effectively.

•     Plan and supervise repairs, renovations, and civil works projects.

•     Manage the allocation, maintenance, and inspection of company housing and staff accommodations.

•     Ensure all company facilities comply with safety, sanitation, and environmental standards.

•     Develop and implement preventive maintenance programs to minimize operational disruptions.

•     Supervise the facilities and construction team, providing leadership, training, and performance oversight.

•     Manage facilities budgets, materials, inventory, and procurement to ensure cost-effective operations.

•     Maintain accurate maintenance records and manage projects using company systems.

•     Support operational activities and oversee building projects as required by the business.

 

Requirements:

•     Civil Engineering qualification (valid for professional use in Guyana).

•     Notion or project-management software experience (on-the-job training if needed).

•     Vendor management and familiarity with EPA / occupational-safety and building regulations.

Coordinate vessel movements, including arrivals, departures, berthing and discharge.

Arrange and monitor vessel stores, supplies and consumables.

Conduct inventory counts and reconcile stock records.

Carry out vessel inspections and report maintenance or operational issues.

Coordinate communication between vessel crew and operations teams.

Maintain shipping, inspection and operational documentation.
